task: High-fidelity neutronic benchmark for sodium-cooled fast reactor validation
key_results: Comprehensive 3D full-core neutronic simulations across seven work packages using Monte Carlo code MCS; reference benchmark established for SFR computer code validation
comments: Provides valuable reference standard for fast reactor simulation but relies on participant-supplied results for four packages, introducing potential validation gaps.

model_io.model: Monte Carlo transport code MCS simulating China Experimental Fast Reactor
inputs: reactor geometry, material compositions, operating conditions, Start-Up Test data
outputs: burnup profiles, neutron spectra, group constants, kinetic parameters, reactivity distributions, transient dynamics

hypotheses.hypothesis: 3D full-core calculations reproduce extended Start-Up Test measurements
hypotheses.result: Confirmed for three empirical packages; results provided for four simulation-based packages

title: Spiders’ gyroscopic motion via web mechanical intelligence facilitates prey sensing
task: Understanding prey localization in orb-weaving spiders via web gyroscopic motion
key_results: Spider body acts as gyroscope coupled to web global vibration; pitch-roll dynamics provide robust prey localization without processing eight independent leg signals; mechanical intelligence offloads cognitive tasks
comments: Novel biomechanical insight demonstrating distributed sensing and computation in biological systems, though generalization to other spider behaviors and prey detection limits remains unclear.

model_io.model: Orb web + spider body dynamical system

hypotheses.hypothesis: Spider body gyroscopic coupling to web provides sufficient mechanical intelligence for prey localization
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; pitch-roll dynamics robustly encode prey location without individual leg processing

title: A room-temperature cavity–magnonic source of correlated microwave magnon polariton pairs
task: Room-temperature generation of correlated microwave magnon polariton pairs
key_results: Non-degenerate magnon polariton pair generation at room temperature with strong intermode correlations; successful microwave communication through two noisy channels
comments: Hybrid magnon-photon platform eliminates millikelvin cooling requirement, but practical scalability to quantum applications requires further demonstration of quantum correlations beyond classical-equivalent behavior.

model_io.model: PCB microstrip resonator coupled to YIG film
inputs: single microwave photon at cavity mode frequency
outputs: pair of magnon polaritons at distinct frequencies with maintained correlations

hypotheses.hypothesis: Magnon-photon nonlinear interactions enable photon-to-polariton pair splitting
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; polariton pairs maintain strong correlations in both linear and nonlinear regimes
